HAPPINESS_FACTORS.FACTOR_HAS_LACKED_DESC: One of the villager's Needs has not been satisfied for some time, incurring a greater decline in Happiness. Once the corresponding Need is fulfilled, their mood will gradually improve.
HAPPINESS_FACTORS.X_VILLAGERS_ARE_LACKING: {IMG1} villagers have lacked {IMG2} too many times.
HAPPINESS_FACTORS.FACTOR_FORCE_HOUSE_SWITCH_DESC: Recently lost their house. Will fade with time.
HAPPINESS_FACTORS.FACTOR_TAXATION_DESC: The villager's house is being or has been taxed. Its occupants' happiness will fluctuate over time to match the estimated tax rate impact. Lowering residential taxation will progressively improve their mood.
HAPPINESS_FACTORS.GOODTALE_HAPPINESSFACTOR_DESC: Your actions made stories of joy spread among your people, but their mood will revert over time.

STATUSES_DESC.NEWCOMER_DESC: Newcomers are hardworking and only require bare essentials to live on.
STATUSES_DESC.SERF_DESC: Serfs are satisfied with a roof over their heads and a welcoming church.
STATUSES_DESC.COMMONER_DESC: Commoners enrich their lives with an abundance of food and goods.
STATUSES_DESC.CITIZEN_DESC: Citizens have developed a taste for luxury and distinction.
STATUSES_DESC.MONK_DESC: Secluded in a monastery, monks live quiet and peaceful lives.
STATUSES_DESC.PRIOR_DESC: Priors are the officials governing a monastery.
STATUSES_DESC.ROOKIE_DESC: Freshly enrolled in the militia, requiring training to become full-fledged soldiers.
STATUSES_DESC.SOLDIER2_DESC: Although experienced, brave soldiers are still a long way from becoming knights.
STATUSES_DESC.KNIGHT_DESC: After rigorous training and arduous missions, knights are capable of anything.
STATUSES_DESC.TRADER_DESC: Traders visit our storage facilities to trade resources and coins according to the rules set in the Royal Book.
STATUSES_DESC.NUN_DESC: The contemplative nuns dedicate themselves to their monastery.
STATUSES_DESC.MERCHANT_DESC: Merchants travel from town to town in search of profitable business opportunities.
STATUSES_DESC.ELDER_DESC: The Elders are respected people serving the cause of the labourers.
STATUSES_DESC.SENESCHAL_DESC: The Seneschal administers royal laws and policies across the realm.

AGENT_ISSUES.VILLAGER_HAS_NO_WORKPLACE: Couldn't find a workplace with the currently assigned job.
AGENT_ISSUES.VILLAGERS_UNEMPLOYED_DESC: Ensuring all villagers are assigned a job and have access to a workplace slot will benefit immigration and your economy.
